title: Claude Code (LLMCode) for GPT-4o, o1, o3‐mini, Llama, Mixtral, Gemini, Deepseek, Qwen
body: I really loved the Claude Code demo, but with sign-ups paused and capacity issues, I decided to take action. I built my own Open Claude Code which can uses GPT-4o, o1, o3‐mini, Llama, Mixtral, Gemini, Deepseek, Qwen, and Claude as base models.Since they all use openai's API specs. It's still in early stages, and I'm looking for feedback and collaborations. ⭐ https://github.com/futureHQ/LLMCode https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66e6ac10-edf3-4518-a567-baedbea37944
author: syscalldev
